01 / THE CAMPAIGN

PREDICT THE CHAMPION.
WIN GOLD.

A Vietnam-focused social giveaway built around the World Cup Final. Fans were invited to predict the winning team, share their excitement and join a prize draw for nine gold rewards.

Participation mechanics

  • Share the official campaign post publicly.
  • Predict the World Cup champion.
  • Tag one Facebook friend.
  • Eligible verified STARTRADER account holders could also enter the Special Prize draw, subject to the official terms.
